description: Sample projects, a lockfile and the installed packages' marker files, with the contributors and the fp1 fingerprint they yield: the native packages and the runtime packages the project's package.json reaches through the lockfile's dependency tree, the project at projectPath from the lockfile's directory, so a monorepo's workspace never hashes a sibling's packages, one entry per name, version and integrity — the lockfile's integrity hash, yarn berry's checksum, else the resolved URL or berry's resolution, else null — and the declared native sources file by file. npm, pnpm and yarn classic record the registry's integrity, so one dependency set yields one fingerprint in the three; yarn berry's checksum is its own. A package the walk reaches is installed or the project is refused, since its markers cannot be read; an optional dependency a platform does not install is skipped with its own dependencies. Each installed copy's markers are read where the lockfile installs it — npm's key, pnpm's virtual store directory, else the nearest node_modules from the package depending on it, as Node resolves it — so a nested copy is never read from a hoisted namesake of another version; a virtual store name pnpm shortened to a prefix and a hash is the one store directory the unshortened name begins with. An aliased dependency, npm: and another package, contributes that package's version and integrity under the name the project declares, in every lockfile. refusedProjects are the projects whose fingerprint cannot be computed.
